children: USA Rare Earth closed its merger with SVRE, delivering $300 million in cash and issuing 126,849,307 shares in private placements exempt from registration. The stock component went to SVRE shareholders, the DFC via warrant conversion, OMF Fund III (F), certain warrant holders, and SVRE employees and consultants. Concurrently, the company entered a Registration Rights Agreement to file a resale registration and maintain effectiveness until the securities are sold or freely tradable, supporting post-merger liquidity.
